tools.name: omise_get_account
tools.description: Return the Omise account behind the secret key: id, email, business details and transfer settings.

tools.name: omise_get_balance
tools.description: Return the current balance: total, transferable and reserve amounts, in the account currency.

tools.name: omise_list_charges
tools.description: List payments (charges). Pass order reverse_chronological for newest first. Filter by status, customer or time window.

tools.name: omise_get_charge
tools.description: Return one charge by id: amount, status, card, refunded amount, failure code and metadata.

tools.name: omise_list_refunds
tools.description: List refunds across the account. Pass order reverse_chronological for newest first.

tools.name: omise_list_charge_refunds
tools.description: List the refunds made against one charge.

tools.name: omise_get_refund
tools.description: Return one refund of a charge by its id: amount, status, reason and metadata.

tools.name: omise_list_customers
tools.description: List customers. Pass order reverse_chronological for newest first.

tools.name: omise_get_customer
tools.description: Return one customer by id: email, description, default card and metadata.

tools.name: omise_list_customer_cards
tools.description: List the saved cards of one customer. Card numbers are masked by Omise.

tools.name: omise_list_disputes
tools.description: List chargebacks (disputes). Pass order reverse_chronological for newest first. Use omise_get_dispute for the evidence due date and amount.

tools.name: omise_get_dispute
tools.description: Return one dispute by id: amount, status, reason, due date and the charge it belongs to.

tools.name: omise_list_events
tools.description: List account events (for example charge.complete or refund.create). Pass order reverse_chronological for newest first.

tools.name: omise_get_event
tools.description: Return one event by id, with the object it describes.

tools.name: omise_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer record (email, description, metadata). Creates no charge and moves no money.

tools.name: omise_update_customer
tools.description: Change a customer's email, description or metadata. Other fields stay unchanged. Setting the same values again has no effect.

tools.name: omise_update_charge
tools.description: Change a charge's description or metadata only. The amount and the payment are not changed.

tools.name: omise_capture_charge
tools.description: Capture an authorized charge so the money moves to the account. Omit capture_amount to capture the full authorized amount. Only charges created without immediate capture can be captured.

tools.name: omise_create_refund
tools.description: Refund money from a charge to the card holder. A refund is final and cannot be undone. The amount cannot exceed the refundable balance of the charge.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "omise_get_account" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the Omise account behind the secret key: id, email, business details and transfer settings.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: omise_get_account, omise_get_customer · Private data: omise_get_account, omise_create_customer · Public sink: omise_get_account, omise_get_customer, omise_create_customer, omise_update_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: omise_get_account, omise_get_customer · Private data: omise_get_account, omise_create_customer · Public sink: omise_get_account, omise_get_customer, omise_create_customer, omise_update_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
